findings.title: Handle requests without an organization member before checking privileges
findings.body: The new privilege check runs even when optimized_pagination is absent and dereferences organization_context.member for every non-superuser. Organization-scoped API-token requests can be authorized to read audit logs without an associated organization member; for those requests, member is None and this raises AttributeError. Existing callers therefore receive a 500 even on the default pagination path. Evaluate this check only for opted-in requests and handle missing membership explicitly.

findings.title: Preserve datetime cursor conversion for audit logs
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint uses this paginator with order_by="-datetime", so get_item_key receives a datetime rather than a number. Calling math.floor or math.ceil on it raises TypeError when build_cursor processes any nonempty page, making optimized audit-log requests fail with a 500. value_from_cursor also returns the numeric cursor unchanged instead of converting it back to a datetime for the database filter. Reuse DateTimePaginator's key encoding and decoding for this endpoint.

findings.title: Do not pass negative slice bounds to a Django QuerySet
findings.body: Django QuerySets reject negative slice bounds; they do not handle them like Python lists. With advanced features enabled, a cursor such as 0:-1:0 reaches this slice and raises ValueError instead of performing the advertised reverse pagination. Reject unsupported offsets with BadPaginationError or implement reverse traversal using valid ordering and nonnegative bounds.
